# Set Colour

Replaces selected splats' base colour with the colour you provide.

`lfs.set_colour` · Splat

## How to use

Pick Colour or connect colours from another node.\
Leave Clear View Dependent on for a flat painted colour.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Where you apply the edit, 0–1: 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 applies it fully. Unconnected means everything. |
| Colour | `Colour` | lfs.colour | [0.5, 0.5, 0.5] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | RGB colour, usually 0–1 per channel: 0 is black, 1 is white. The default (0.5, 0.5, 0.5) is mid grey. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Clear View Dependent | `clear_view_dependent` | bool | true | — | Remove camera-dependent colour on selected splats. On by default gives flat colour; off retains reflections. |
